summary: Iteration 2 — Cosmic Elemental Phase 2 (subscriptions, 6% commission, participant registrations, ticket-type override, flyer reorder, featured artists, share OG endpoint, INR currency, emails) tested end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py (13 new pytest cases) — 13/13 PASS. Phase 1 suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) untouched. Ran Playwright UI flows: /pricing (3 plan cards + Most popular badge on artist + ₹60 example), signup → dashboard (all 5 tabs — events/registrations/classes/artist/subscription — present), subscription tab (3 dash-plan cards, viewer free trial button clickable), event detail (share-wa/tw/fb/copy buttons + registration-modal opens + carousel-prev/next present when >1 flyer), admin featured tab (list of approved artists with toggle-feature button, click flips featured state with toast). Admin stats card visible with new fields: Featured artists, Active subs, Total commission (₹120 during run) — currency INR confirmed. No frontend fixes needed.

issues: When the user has no events yet, the entire toolbar (event selector, search, sort, filter, Export CSV) is hidden and replaced with a single 'Create an event first' message. Fine as an empty state but users landing directly on the tab can't tell the feature exists. Consider showing the disabled toolbar with a hint.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L679-688: /payments/status only calls _post_payment_success when transitioning from non-paid → paid via the Stripe status lookup. If the tx doc is already payment_status='paid' (e.g. flipped by webhook first) and the client hits /payments/status/{sid} afterwards, no side-effects run — which is correct, but it means the DB-simulation shortcut proposed in the review request (direct set payment_status='paid' then GET /payments/status) does NOT create a registration row on its own. Tests worked around this by inserting the registration inline mirroring _post_payment_success. Consider extracting a small helper `ensure_registration_row(session_id)` that can be called idempotently from both webhook and status endpoints — makes the flow more testable.

server.py L785: CORS is still allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True (carried over from Phase 1). Browsers ignore Set-Cookie on this combo; Bearer works fine so tests pass, but SPA cookie login is effectively unavailable. Same recommendation as iteration 1.

server.py L710: _post_payment_success uses `if existing: return` guarding double-fire — good. But the participant field is loaded from `rec.get('participant') or {}`; if a webhook fires before the transaction doc has the participant merged (race), the registration row will be missing name/phone/category. Consider requiring participant presence and returning early with a log.

emails.py L10: `if not to or not EMAIL_KEY: … return` — email send silently noops when key is unset. Correct behavior for tests, but a startup log line stating 'Emails disabled (no EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY)' would help ops.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (pricing, dashboard tabs, subscription plans, event detail share/carousel/registration modal, admin featured toggle)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files now live in /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (phase 1, 19 tests) and test_phase2.py (phase 2, 13 tests). Run both with `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -n 0 -v`. rca of the issue: No new bugs uncovered in Phase 2. Two initial UI-test failures were false negatives caused by test-script issues (case-sensitive 'Most popular' match; `?mode=signup` query not honored — must click auth-tab-signup).
